article.title: STRONG prehabilitation before elective ventral hernia repair: Learnings from recruitment challenges in a randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Jensen SAS, Lauridsen SV, Fonnes S
article.abstract: The impact of smoking, nutrition, alcohol, and physical inactivity (SNAP) on the outcome of ventral hernia repair remains underexplored. This trial aimed to evaluate the effect of targeted, intensive lifestyle prehabilitation on postoperative complications.
